notices.title: OpenCode Console breach: check your API keys
notices.message: Security notice for OpenCode users: on 17 October OpenCode reported unauthorized access to a legacy OpenCode Console system. Provider API keys some users had saved in a Console workspace (OpenAI, Anthropic and others) may have been exposed. OpenCode emailed the affected users: if you got that email, revoke and replace those keys and check their recent usage. The opencode CLI itself is not reported as affected.

zh-CN.title: OpenCode Console 遭入侵：请检查你的 API 密钥
zh-CN.message: OpenCode 用户安全提示：OpenCode 于 10 月 17 日报告，其旧版 OpenCode Console 系统遭到未授权访问。部分用户保存在 Console 工作区中的提供商 API 密钥（OpenAI、Anthropic 等）可能已泄露。OpenCode 已向受影响的用户发送邮件：如果你收到了该邮件，请吊销并更换这些密钥，并检查近期用量。目前没有报告称 opencode CLI 本身受到影响。
zh-CN.label: 查看 OpenCode 公告
